visual_severity_assessment.abstention_reason: OFFICIAL CONDITION STATE ABSTENTION: An official bridge condition state (e.g. AASHTO MBEI CS1-CS4 or NBIS Item 58-60 ratings) CANNOT be established from 2D optical imagery alone. Grounded structural assessment requires unobservable parameters: structural component identity, primary/secondary load path importance, defect depth, rebar section loss, and physical metric calibration. Consequently, the official structural condition state is marked NOT_ASSESSED.

confidence_contract.confidence_distinction_notice: CONFIDENCE CONTRACT: The reported confidence score is the mean pixel-level classification probability produced by the neural network segmentation model. This indicates optical pattern clarity, NOT calibrated engineering confidence in structural severity or safety risk.

structural_component_identity.required_source: Bridge BIM, element segmentation, or engineering inspection plan.
structural_component_identity.description: Specific structural element (e.g. pier column, fracture-critical girder, deck slab).

element_importance.required_source: National Bridge Inventory (NBI) / AASHTO Element records.
element_importance.description: Primary load-bearing vs. secondary vs. non-structural appurtenance.

physical_defect_dimensions.required_source: Optical rangefinder, calibrated stereo rig, or fiducial scale.
physical_defect_dimensions.description: Metric crack width (mm), spall surface area (m^2), or rebar span (m).

internal_defect_depth.required_source: Non-destructive testing (GPR, ultrasonic pulse velocity, impact echo).
internal_defect_depth.description: Subsurface void depth, delamination plane, or crack penetration depth.

reinforcement_section_loss.required_source: Physical caliper measurement, ultrasonic thickness gauge, or electrochemistry.
reinforcement_section_loss.description: Residual rebar diameter, percentage cross-sectional area loss.

inspection_history.required_source: Historical bridge inspection agency database (e.g. AASHTO BrM).
inspection_history.description: Defect progression rate, date of first observation, active vs dormant status.

engineering_assessment.required_source: Licensed Professional Engineer (PE / SE) field evaluation.
engineering_assessment.description: Certified structural capacity determination and maintenance work order sign-off.
